quest.title: Insights of Drifting Dreams
quest.description: Under Xiao's guidance, you prepare to use adepti arts to recover the Sigil of Permission and warn the false adeptus of his evil ways. You will confront the false adeptus in a dream and teach him a lesson...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x550, Primogem x60, Mora x38100, Guide to Prosperity x5, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

talks.objective: Go to the southern face of Mt. Tianheng
Talk to the protector of the shrine

dialogues.speaker: Pervases
dialogues.text: The spirit soars the mountains high, while the body rests as the world goes by...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... Sorry to interrupt you, but...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'd like to borrow a censer and some lamps.

dialogues.speaker: Pervases
dialogues.text: Well I'll be... Isn't that something?

dialogues.speaker: Pervases
dialogues.text: A pair walk into a shrine, neither to seek nor worship gods or adepti, but to pilfer the tools of worship for their own ends. Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We know it's rude to ask, but we just need them for a short while — honest!

dialogues.speaker: Pervases
dialogues.text: For the Dream Trawler ritual, I trust?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wha— How'd you know that?

dialogues.speaker: Pervases
dialogues.text: I have been in this shrine for far longer than you would expect.

dialogues.speaker: Pervases
dialogues.text: Perhaps as a reward for my faithfulness, I have been endowed with some understanding of the adepti arts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow. Paimon's never heard of that happening before.

dialogues.speaker: Pervases
dialogues.text: Ah, it matters not. Take what you need. It is a fortuitous thing that these items may be of service to you.

dialogues.speaker: Pervases
dialogues.text: ...They served little purpose here, in any case.

response.speaker: Pervases
response.text: Heh, nothing that you need concern yourself with. Please, take what you wish.

response.speaker: Pervases
response.text: You are quite welcome. Please, take what you wish.

talks.objective: Collect the items needed for the ritual: Censer

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This censer... should be fine... right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: At least it isn't as run-down as this shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So next... we just need to grab the Seven-Star Lamps, right? The sooner we start, the sooner we'll be done.

talks.objective: Collect the items necessary for the ritual: Seven-Star Lamps

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Where'd he go!? He was right here...

dialogues.speaker: Statue
dialogues.text: I had presumed that once you had acquired what you came for, you would forget about me and simply be on your way...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! It's that guy's voice! ...Hello? Wh—Where are you?

dialogues.speaker: Statue
dialogues.text: My physical form ceased to exist over a thousand years ago. What you witnessed earlier was an illusion, created by the adepti art known as Mortal Lingering.

dialogues.speaker: Statue
dialogues.text: Now that you have taken the Seven-Star Lamps and censer used in the Mortal Lingering ritual, my form is no longer visible to you.

response.speaker: Statue
response.text: I was once a junior in the order of the yakshas, bestowed with the name Pervases by Rex Lapis himself. Yet my strength failed, and I was slain in battle.

response.speaker: Statue
response.text: Today is the anniversary of my death. My last wish was to see a modern Liyue, and so I took the liberty of performing this ritual here.

response.speaker: Statue
response.text: That aside... You were sent here by the Conqueror of Demons, were you not?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, you two know each other then?

response.speaker: Statue
response.text: I sense his aura upon you... that, and the heavy burden of his karma.

response.speaker: Statue
response.text: *sigh* Even after all these millennia, he still must endure such tremendous suffering?

response.speaker: Statue
response.text: ...I am truly ashamed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't say that, Pervases — you sacrificed your life for Liyue, didn't you?

response.speaker: Statue
response.text: Life is a precious thing, yes... But when I think of the burden that the Conqueror of Demons must bear... *sigh* death seems to me to have been the easy way out. A selfish indulgence, even.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pervases...

response.speaker: Statue
response.text: Haha, I apologize. Birthdays are joyful occasions, but by the same token, it is hard to not be melancholy on the anniversary of one's death.

response.speaker: Statue
response.text: The Mortal Lingering will not last much longer. Take care, you two, and please pass on my regards to the Conqueror of Demons...

response.speaker: Statue
response.text: *sigh* If only I could taste some authentic Grilled Ticker Fish once more...

response.speaker: Statue
response.text: By wave and storm I hunt for fish, by wind and snow I slay evil...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Looks like he's gone, then... Paimon really hopes that at least someone will remember Pervases the Yaksha.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We should get going. But let's come back here and make an offering sometime.

response.speaker: Statue
response.text: Haha... It is not untrue to say this. The line between adepti and ghosts is a fine one indeed.

talks.objective: Collect the items needed for the ritual: Mist Flowers
Head to the yaksha statues after nightfall

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Have you gathered the items for the ritual?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Hmm... This censer, and these lamps... Their designs are flawless, almost as if they were made specifically for use in the adepti arts. Where did you come by them?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We got them from a yaksha named Pervases...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! And um, he says hi!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Pervases...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...Yes, this does have the hallmarks of something Pervases might do.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: As I thought, it seems that he could not leave Liyue behind either... I hope that its present state will allow him to rest in peace.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Well then. Let us begin preparing for the ritual.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Place the censer in the middle, and surround it with the Seven-Star Lamps. Adorn the area with the items of abject cold. Once this is done, we shall proceed.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Yes, this will do. Now, the next step is the key to performing Dream Trawler...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: There are four steps to performing this ritual: offering incense, meditation, incantation, and loosing an arrow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah... Seems like a real rigmarole.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Adepti arts are the product of millennia of study by adepti. Do not dismiss their mystical workings as "rigmarole."

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Failure to take this seriously could cause the technique to devour one's own body, or cause the spirit to be sundered from one's flesh permanently...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Agh! Stop talking! Paimon's sorry!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: When offering the incense, we place the incense into the censer with reverence for Rex Lapis in our hearts.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Meditation is to empty ourselves of trivial thoughts, and to focus on the target of the art we are performing.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Then, we shall recite the incantation in a loud voice: "Devayaksha, Bring Forth Sin!"

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Finally, we will loose an arrow towards each of the yaksha statues to enlist their authority for our contract.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: If all goes well, Starsnatcher's soul will be brought forth shortly.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: If you have no other questions, let us begin.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Well... let's start by offering up incense, shall we? You know, with respect for Rex Lapis and everything...

talks.objective: Initiate the ritual according to the correct process

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then we meditate... Ugh, Paimon really doesn't wanna think about that fraud!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ohh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ahh... Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh... Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Devayaksha, Bring Forth Sin!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, bring forth sin!

talks.objective: Fire arrows at the glowing area of the yaksha statues as per the ritual process

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We finished the ritual, and we followed all the instructions to the letter!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...Close enough.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Leave the rest to me. You two get ready to greet him.

dialogues.speaker: Starsnatcher
dialogues.text: Where is one... Huh? You two look familiar.

dialogues.speaker: Starsnatcher
dialogues.text: What's with one's body? One feels... light. Weightless!

choices.text: We summoned your spirit forth with an adepti art.

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: An adepti art? Hahaha! You dare don the guise of an adeptus in one's presence?

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: But as for the matter of one's present location... One could have sworn that one was dozing off to sleep at Wangshu Inn not a moment ago...

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: Wait... that must be it... of course it must! Haha, as expected of an adeptus such as oneself...

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: One must indeed be in a dream!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, there's no helping this guy, is there?

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: Huh? What is the meaning of this? Do you truly think that one will permit such insolence in one's own dreams?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Alright, time to take him down a peg.

choices.text: Dreamers, after all, feel no pain.

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: Dead!?

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: Impossible! One was just lying in peaceful repose at Wangshu Inn...

dialogues.speaker: Starsnatcher
dialogues.text: P—Please, stop! I surrender, I surrender! Argh...

choices.text: So, do you believe us now?

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: Yes! Yes, I do! I thought I was going to die...

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: How did I ever have the misfortune to meet you two...

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: Please, great adepti, spare my life. I won't do this ever again, I swear it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We did call your spirit here, but we're not adepti. He, however, is.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: You deceive the masses with quackery, masquerade as an adeptus, exorcise demons without exterminating them, and display a callous lack of regard for life.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: One day, you will reap that which you have sown... For those who invite the infernal into their lives, there is no redemption!

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: Ah... I... You're...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems like Xiao's got him scared stiff.

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: O great adeptus... might I ask your name?

choices.text: He is the Conqueror of Demons.

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: It really is you! It's truly you! Never in my life did I imagine that I might meet the Conqueror of Demons, the Vigilant Yaksha himself!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know about Xiao?

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: Of course! My grandfather was a folklorist — I learned the tales of the Conqueror of Demons at his knee...

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: To this day, I am an avid collector of books concerning the yakshas.

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: But ever since I discovered a Sigil of Permission while rummaging through my grandfather's personal effects...

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: At first, I was just imitating the adepti for fun... but slowly I began to stray further and further from the righteous path...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, so to sum you up... you're Xiao's biggest fan?

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: Y—Yes. Thank you both for allowing me to witness the Conqueror of Demons in the flesh — it's like a dream come true!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, that wasn't quite our intention...

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: Please allow me to swear this oath before the Great Conqueror of Demons...

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: I swear to turn away from evil, to live an honest life, and to never again stain the name of the adepti!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I will remember your oath... Now go.

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: Thank you... A thousand thanks for your forgiveness... and for all that you have done for Liyue...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He seemed very earnest when he was making that oath there. Guess he won't be tricking anyone anymore.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, wait! We haven't gotten the Sigil of Permission back yet. Let's head over to Wangshu Inn first thing tomorrow and look for him!

choices.text: So, are we still going to do this "oneself" song and dance?

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: N—No, no, never again! Y—You almost killed me...

talks.objective: Go to Wangshu Inn and ask Verr Goldet about the false adeptus

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, Boss. Starsnatcher's staying here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Starsnatcher... Hm... You mean the false adeptus who wore a mask?

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: He signed in here under the name Wang Ping'an.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: He's already checked out. He said he wished to go on a solo pilgrimage...

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: Ah, yes. He also requested that I give this letter to a traveler who journeys together with a "talking fairy"... should they come asking for him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Talking fairy... Who's that?

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: ...Well anyway, you must be the traveler. Here's the letter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How strange that he would leave a letter for us. Is this the final attempt to fool us, maybe?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, open it! Paimon's curious!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, seems like he actually left us a few nice trinkets...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Along with... Woohoo! The Sigil of Permission!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon hasn't met a bad guy like him in a long time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... Anyway, let's go take this Sigil of Permission to Xiao, shall we?

choices.text: This is all thanks to Xiao.
So a really, really ordinary person after all.

talks.objective: Talk to Xiao and give him the Sigil of Permission

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! There you are.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We got the Sigil of Permission back. Do you wanna take it?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You have my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: May I take your order, sir?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: One Grilled Ticker Fish.

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: Certainly, we'll prepare it for you immediately!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? No Almond Tofu this time? Well that's not like Xiao.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Ticker Fish was Pervases' favorite dish...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I just wanted to... see how it tastes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: By wave and storm I hunt for fish, by wind and snow I slay evil...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Was there anything else? I... am accustomed to eating alone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh huh! And so, Detective Paimon and the trusty Traveler solved the case, and quietly slipped away...

dialogues.speaker: Pervases
dialogues.text: Heh, nothing that you need concern yourself with. Please, take what you wish.
